Significant events during the quarter
Jul 20, 2026: The merger with Fingerprint Cards was completed, laying the foundations for a stronger, more competitive Precise, with a broader offering and better conditions for profitable growth.

Aug 13, 2026: The rights issue provided the company with approximately SEK 100 million before issue costs and strengthened the financial conditions for integration, realization of cost synergies and commercial development.
Sep 3, 2026: PamirAI chose FPC AllKey Pro for its new AI Agent Computer, confirming the technology’s competitiveness and opening up opportunities in new areas of application.

Sep 11, 2026: A new distribution partnership with AqTronics strengthened Precise’s commercial presence in India and Vietnam and created new opportunities to reach customers in two important growth markets.
Sep 15, 2026: The continued collaboration with IOTRUST on the next generation of D'CENT crypto wallets confirmed Precise’s strong position in the field of secure biometric authentication.
Sep 29, 2026: Corporate management was strengthened with a clearer commercial and product-oriented organization to accelerate integration and drive the company’s continued development.
Significant events after the end of the interim period

Oct 1, 2026: Precise Visit was expanded with integrated queue management, which broadened the offering in visitor management and boosted opportunities to meet customers’ needs for efficient and secure visitor flows.

Oct 15, 2026: Precise received two new orders to a total value of approximately SEK 15 million, with revenue expected in 2027. The deals confirmed the competitiveness of the company’s offering and strengthened the conditions for continued growth in secure biometric authentication.
Presentation and live Q&A
Precise has published a video interview with CEO Joakim Nydemark in connection with this report. The video is available on the Investor Relations page: precisebiometrics.com/investors/.

The Company will also host a live Q&A on the day of the report. More information and a registration link to the Q&A session may be found on the Investor Relations page: precisebiometrics.com/investors/.
CEO Joakim Nydemark comments

“We have made significant progress with the integration, strengthened our commercial organization, and are already seeing tangible results through new business expected to generate revenue in 2027. The results for the quarter reflect the costs we need to incur to complete the integration, realize cost synergies, and build a stronger company. We are fully focused on building a company with a stronger offering in biometric security, access, and identity, creating greater customer value, new business opportunities, and a stronger position higher up the value chain.”
About Precise Biometrics

Precise Biometrics AB (publ) (“Precise”) is a Swedish-rooted global leader in biometrics, providing trusted access and identity solutions that securely verify and identify people across physical and digital environments.

Guided by our vision of making everyday life safer and more seamless in a world where YOU are the key, we combine biometric hardware systems, algorithms, cloud solutions, and decades of domain expertise to help protect identities, places, devices, data, and digital services against fraud, identity threats, and unauthorized access. Applications range from mobile phones and consumer electronics to physical and logical enterprise access, visitor management, and government identity programs, powering hundreds of millions of devices and authentications every day.
Precise has a strong global presence with local teams across Europe, North America, and Asia. The company is headquartered in Lund, Sweden, and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (PREC).
